name: EgoSuite-Open100K (EgoStandard)
tagline: Head-view line of EgoSuite-Open100K: 90,000 h planned (80K h hand pose + 10K h full body); ~10,757 h delivered as MCAP when measured.

annotations.format: MCAP (embedded Protobuf topics: /pose/*, /annotation/*, foxglove.CompressedVideo); card also promises LeRobot v3
annotations.coverageNote: Sampled episodes carry 21-joint hand pose, head/headcam pose and semantic segments; 22-joint body pose only in EgoStandard-body. No depth or audio topic found.

action_labels.note: Skill tags + start/end time per segment; task_description per episode

hand_pose.note: 21 joints per hand, world-frame position + quaternion (float32)

body_pose.note: 22-joint full body (EgoStandard-body sub-SKU, 10,000 of 90,000 h planned)

gaze.note: Right-eye camera pose topic only; no gaze vector

depth.note: head_depth declared in metadata but never published in sampled episodes

samples.caption: Project-page sample: head-view frame of a home task (folding and storing a T-shirt)
